title: Masroor Rock-Cut Temple, Kangra: History, Timings and How to Reach
seo_title: Masroor Rock Cut Temple, Kangra: History, Timings & How to Reach
seo_desc: The Masroor rock-cut temples near Kangra: a group of 8th-century Nagara-style shrines carved from one ridge of sandstone, damaged in the 1905 earthquake and now protected by the ASI. History, what to see, timings and how to reach from Dharamshala.
